country.description: The two-letter country code, such as US

items.description: An email address invoices go to

type.description: MAIN_SENDER for the main recipient, or CC or BCC

name_on_invoice.description: The name printed on invoices, when it differs

payment_terms.description: Days the customer has to pay an invoice

send_invoices_automatically.description: Whether Rillet emails invoices on their date

send_payment_reminders.description: Whether Rillet reminds the customer to pay

updated_at.description: When it last changed, as an ISO 8601 time in UTC

description: Run accounting in Rillet: sync customers and vendors, create invoices and bills, record payments, post journal entries, read contracts and pull the income statement and balance sheet.

rillet_new_bill_trigger.description: Runs when a bill is entered in Rillet.

output.items: The bill's lines, each with an account code and an amount and its currency.
output.status: DRAFT, UNPAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, PAID or CREDITED.

rillet_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs when a customer is added in Rillet.

output.emails: Where invoices are emailed: each with email and type.
output.name: The customer's name.
output.name_on_invoice: The name printed on invoices, if it differs.
output.payment_terms: Days the customer has to pay an invoice.

rillet_new_invoice_trigger.description: Runs when an invoice is created in Rillet.

output.amount_due: What is still owed: an amount and its currency.
output.contract_id: The contract it was billed from, if any.
output.invoice_number: The invoice number, such as INV01.
output.status: UNPAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, PAID, UNBILLED or CREDITED.
output.total: The total including tax: an amount and its currency.
